caption: A cement mixer rumbles beside a garden wall, and pebbles on the wall's top shiver and shift.

sa.check: A cement mixer beside a garden wall.
Pebbles lie on top of the wall.
The mixer is running: its drum turns.
The pebbles stay on the wall.

pc.expect: The pebbles move only while the drum turns and are still when it is stopped.
pc.fail: Pebbles shift while the drum is plainly still; or keep shifting after the drum has stopped; or slide along the wall in one smooth glide.

pc.expect: While the mixer runs, the pebbles tremble and end up in a new arrangement.
pc.fail: The drum turns for the whole clip and the pebbles sit frozen; or the pebbles return to their exact starting spots after moving; or pebbles far from the mixer shift while those nearest it sit still.

pc.expect: Pebbles stay on the wall top; any that leave it fall.
pc.fail: A pebble hovers; or rises; or a pebble that leaves the wall floats sideways.

pc.expect: The pebbles and the wall are rigid; the drum turns on its frame.
pc.fail: The wall ripples; or pebbles squash; or the drum wobbles off its frame and stays there.

pc.expect: The pebbles keep their count; one mixer; nothing passes into the wall.
pc.fail: Pebbles appear from nowhere; or vanish; or sink into the wall; or the mixer duplicates.

pc.expect: The mixer's colour, the wall's stones and the pebbles' colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The mixer changes colour; or the wall's stones change; or the pebbles change colour.
